outlook.statement: The Company is engaged in expanding its business operations, particularly its technology-driven precious metals platform www.goldnsilver.shop, e-commerce activities and allied business initiatives.

FY 2025-26 represents an important year in the Company's transition from operational recovery towards a more focused growth strategy with emphasis on e-commerce, trading and technology-enabled business opportunities
Life 108 Healthcare Private Limited will continue to improve its performance consistently for the current year
BeastBells Media Private Limited will continue to focus on strengthening its operations, improving revenues and enhancing profitability in the coming financial year
Development of GoldnSilver.shop as an integrated technology-driven platform for precious metals trading and distribution through partnerships and technology integrations
Volume Acceleration: Scale turnover pipelines within the high-velocity Trading segment to command higher B2B market share.
Digital Monetization: Convert live beta insights into active, recurring transaction volumes on GoldnSilver.shop via aggressive digital marketing campaigns.
Margin Defensibility: Protect capital by utilizing internal digital workflows, keeping administrative costs lean as top-line revenues grow.
Long-Term Value: Drive compounding shareholder wealth through corporate transparency, lower debt, and innovative asset allocation.
Moving past beta validation into a comprehensive commercial launch of GoldnSilver.shop, paired with a dedicated mobile application to scale active consumer acquisition.

Expansion of proprietary GoldnSilver.shop branded bullion range, precious metals gifting marketplace, automated multi-asset SIPs, multi-lender integration for instant gold-backed loan originations, AI-enabled portfolio recommendations, international market connectivity via GIFT IFSC, dedicated native mobile apps, nationwide expansion of affiliate/franchise/retail partner networks, B2B offerings for corporate treasury solutions & institutional bullion procurement.

risks: No major risks were noticed during the year which may threaten the existence of the Company

Competitive and Marketplace Risk: High competition from established marketplaces, large retailers, specialized digital platforms and emerging D2C players; dependence on third-party platforms like Amazon and Flipkart exposes to policy, commission, algorithm and commercial term changes.

Precious Metals Price and Market Risk: Gold/silver ecosystem influenced by international bullion prices, currency movements, interest rates, geopolitical developments and domestic demand; volatility may affect customer behavior, transaction volumes, inventory management and margins.

Regulatory and Compliance Risk: Activities involving physical precious metals, digital gold/silver and proposed financial/investment services subject to evolving regulatory, tax, KYC, consumer-protection and compliance requirements.

Technology, Cybersecurity and Data Protection Risk: Reliance on digital platforms, APIs, payment gateways and third-party integrations; cyberattacks, data breaches, system failures or third-party disruptions could affect operations and customer confidence.

Third-Party and Partner Dependency: Dependence on marketplaces, bullion suppliers, technology providers, payment gateways, logistics providers; disruptions or regulatory issues affecting partners could impact operations.

Execution and Scalability Risk: GoldnSilver.shop success depends on timely technology integration, customer adoption, product availability, strategic partnerships and ability to scale efficiently; new initiatives may require additional investment before meaningful revenue/profitability.
B2B Business and Credit Risk: Customer concentration, longer collection cycles, credit exposure to institutional/corporate customers.
Reputation and Customer Confidence: Trust, transparency, product authenticity and timely fulfillment critical in precious metals; deficiencies could adversely affect reputation.
Company has a well-defined risk management policy in place and follows balanced risk to return strategy
